General Social Survey

General Social Survey

A repeated cross-sectional survey of US adults, 1972 to 2024, about attitudes, behaviors and attributes.

Publisher
NORC at the University of Chicago
Dataset
https://gss.norc.org/
Terms
https://gss.norc.org/terms-and-conditions.html
The 2024 Release 3a codebook grants permission to use, copy, modify, publish and distribute it, provided NORC's copyright and permission notice is included and distribution is free of charge (see NOTICE.md). NORC's terms page asks for citation and disclaims warranty; it does not address redistributing the public-use data files. Allen Downey decided the data files may ship, because they are freely downloadable public-use files.
Citation
Davern, Michael; Bautista, Rene; Freese, Jeremy; Herd, Pamela; and Morgan, Stephen L.; General Social Survey 1972-2024. [Machine-readable data file]. Principal Investigator, Michael Davern; Co-Principal Investigators, Rene Bautista, Jeremy Freese, Pamela Herd, and Stephen L. Morgan. NORC ed. Chicago, 2026. 1 datafile (Release 3a) and 1 codebook (2024 Release 3a).
